meta.homeTitle: Escape Away · Managed stays in Egypt
meta.description: Book a managed stay in Cairo, Sheikh Zayed, the North Coast, El Alamein or Gouna directly with Escape Away. 400+ homes, one team, support around the clock.
meta.about: Escape Away Hospitality is a hospitality company based in New Cairo, Egypt. It turns apartments, chalets and villas into furnished homes for short and medium stays, and runs 400+ of them across Cairo, Sheikh Zayed, the North Coast, El Alamein and Gouna, from design and furnishing to guest support around the clock.

faq.a1: Pick your dates and guests on a stay and send a request. The team checks the dates, replies on WhatsApp and sends a secure Paymob payment link to confirm.
faq.a2: No. Your name, WhatsApp number and email are enough.
faq.a3: By card, through the Paymob payment link the team sends once your dates are confirmed.
faq.q4: Can I stay for a month or longer?
faq.a4: Yes. Escape Away runs short and medium stays; ask the team for monthly stays.
faq.q5: Is someone there if I need help during my stay?
faq.a5: Yes. Guest support runs around the clock, every day.
faq.a6: Reservations, listings and pricing, guest communication, housekeeping, maintenance and photography, with reporting for the owner.
faq.q7: My unit is already furnished. Can you still take it?
faq.a7: Yes. Escape Away can manage it as it is, or restyle it first.
